biotools.summary: This package analyze spatial transcriptomics data through cross-regional cell type-specific analysis. It selects regions of interest (ROIs) and identifys cross-regional cell type-specific differential signals. The ROIs can be selected using automatic algorithm or through manual selection. It facilitates manual selection of ROIs using a shiny application.
